test_title: PYST 13: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom to fill in the blank.

____________, French was the most difficult language for Shruti.
solution:
The correct answer is: **By far**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"By far"** means by a great amount; to a great extent. (अब तक, बहुत अधिक)
 
• **​"By far"** is used to emphasize that something is the most extreme example or the highest degree of something.
 
 
• **Example: By far**, French was the most difficult language for Shruti.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Bear out** (समर्थन करना): To support or confirm something.

 
 
• **Example:** The evidence will **bear out** his testimony.
 
 
 
• **Break into** (घुसना): To enter forcibly.
 
 
• **Example:** Thieves **broke into** the house last night.
 
 
 
• **Be in the air** (हवा में होना): Something that is happening or felt by many people to be happening or going to happen.
 
 
• **Example:** There is excitement **in the air** as the festival approaches.
 
 

40:Taed,

The correct answer is: **Option 1**.</
